findings.namedBuyers: Verified organizer leadership contacts: Steve Schwed, CFCA COO; Stacy Graham, CCSP, CFCA President. Both are relevant routing or relationship-development contacts by virtue of their leadership roles (inference); neither is verified as the hotel contracting buyer. Source: https://cfca.org/our-team/
findings.futureEdition: Exact dates are announced: 26–28 April 2027. The current official event detail, main events listing and venue listing now agree. The programme specifies a welcome reception Monday 26 April, full programme and evening networking Tuesday 27 April, and full programme Wednesday 28 April. This resolves the previously reported disagreement between the website listing and detailed schedule. An older CFCA LinkedIn announcement dated 14 October 2026 still states 27–29 April; no explicit change notice was found. Use 26–28 April as the currently published official dates, with written reconfirmation before contracting.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: explore a modest delegate or speaker lodging allocation at the 157-room hotel, not displacement of the announced TD Bank meeting venue. No published room demand establishes a block size. Catering suitability has not been assessed.
findings.venueCommitments: Published host: TD Bank. Published venue: TD Terrace, 160 Front St W, Toronto, Ontario M5J 0G4, Canada. This is a corporate-office venue, not a host hotel. Publication establishes the announced venue, not access to a signed venue agreement.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing unconfirmed. The reviewed official event and venue pages name no accommodation partner, room block, hotel booking link or accommodation buyer. Absence of a published block does not establish an open hotel procurement process.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No incumbent hotel or overflow requirement is identified on the reviewed event page. Do not portray unspecified hotel inventory as open or overflow as demonstrated.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Write to the published general organizer address fraud@cfca.org, requesting routing to Steve Schwed or the accommodation/event operations lead. Cite the now-consistent official 26–28 April schedule, request written reconfirmation because the older social announcement differs, and ask whether a hotel partner or block exists, who handles accommodation, and whether a modest delegate/speaker allocation can still be considered. Do not quote a room commitment before demand and procurement status are confirmed.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 edition is announced and ticketed, but accommodation procurement access is not established. Its published corporate venue does not itself rule out separate lodging discussions.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Obtain written organizer confirmation of 26–28 April 2027 before contracting or making non-refundable arrangements.
Ask the organizer for the accommodation decision-maker and any existing hotel block or unsatisfied lodging need.
remainingUncertainties: No explicit date-change notice reconciles the older 27–29 April social announcement with the now-consistent 26–28 April official website schedule.
Accommodation buyer, hotel commitments, procurement availability, attendance and peak room requirements remain unpublished in the reviewed event materials.
